date: # Dated Tesla autonomy milestones. area: Robotaxi
market: Optimus. One row per event. Primary source where Tesla published one (its quarterly Update or an SEC filing); otherwise the press report the date was taken from. 'verify' = date or status not confirmed by a primary source.

event: All new Teslas ship with hardware Tesla says is capable of full self-driving
FSD Beta starts rolling out to a small group of US owners
note: start date Tesla's CEO announced; owners reported access from 22 Oct 2020 (press reports)

event: FSD renamed FSD (Supervised) with v12.3.3, released with a free one-month trial to US and Canadian owners
note: press report: the new name first shipped in software 2024.3.10 on Saturday 30 Mar 2024 (also Tesla North's release notes, 30 Mar 2024, https://teslanorth.com/2024/03/30/2024-3-10-release-notes-fsd-supervised-12-3-3); US trial emails went out from 29 Mar on the previous version (https://teslanorth.com/2024/03/29/tesla-full-self-driving-trials-begin-email/)

event: Cybercab two-seat robotaxi unveiled at the We Robot event
City-streets driver assistance (partial FSD features) pushed to cars in China, in batches
note: press report of Tesla's notice to owners; less capable than the US version

event: Robotaxi service starts in Austin with a safety monitor in the front passenger seat (invite-only)
note: Tesla 2025 proxy statement: launched 22 Jun 2025 with safety riders

event: Ride-hailing opens in the San Francisco Bay Area with a safety driver in the driver's seat
note: press report: @Tesla_AI posted on Wednesday 30 Jul 2025 that Bay Area invites were going out (Tesla North, 31 Jul 2025, https://teslanorth.com/2025/07/31/tesla-brings-robotaxi-service-to-san-francisco-bay-area); launch confirmed in Tesla's Q3 2025 Update

event: FSD (Supervised) launched in Australia and New Zealand (HW4 cars)
note: press report of Tesla's launch post

event: Tesla reports it began removing the safety monitor from some Austin customer rides in January
note: Q4 2025 Update gives the month (January 2026) not the day; row dated on the Update, released 28 Jan 2026 (SEC 8-K)

event: Tesla reports unsupervised Robotaxi rides launched in Dallas and Houston in April; Cybercab pilot production started
Tesla reports Robotaxi live in seven US metros, with unsupervised rides in Miami, Orlando and Tampa from July
UK: FSD (Supervised) not approved; no approval announced by Tesla or the government by this date
note: status as of this date; the Vehicle Certification Agency said on 9 Oct 2026 it had not undertaken any type approval activity, and the Dutch RDW approval (10 Apr 2026) does not apply in Great Britain (EV Compared, checked 1 Nov 2026)

event: Hong Kong: FSD sold but not approved for use; one-time purchase ended 30 Jun 2026 (subscription only)
note: status as of this date per a tracker site and press (gagadget, 28 Jun 2026: the Transport Department has not granted approval for public use); no Tesla or Transport Department statement found - verify
